final: SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS avg_daily_rate, AVG(avg_daily_rate - mean_daily_rate) AS avg_excess_daily_rate FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rate, AVG(AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration)) OVER () AS mean_daily_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating) WHERE avg_daily_rate > mean_daily_rate
